delta_reviews.rationale: For a068, the compact Dune Valley Lower series sentence affirmatively documents the hot-drink reconstitution subject and drinking-chocolate powder, while the later commercial-ledger sentence expressly excludes experimental performance. Both contexts are therefore present, independently of any required diagnostic label. The two distributions are CSV and JSON with the same reporting month, unit price and consignment columns and identical within-record examples. The metadata lacks the extra JSON distribution and the expanded reuse prose seen in 39031; it also omits the optional spatial text. These are genuine seeded format/length/optional-field changes, not a new experimental claim. The administrative facts and topic association remain consistent with both other seeds; prices, counts, location and publisher are seed-specific. The original ledger observation remains valid, with a truthful administrative basis and a separately documented empty-facts topical context now recorded.

Complete comparison across a091-a100 in all three seeds preserves the conceptual product, process, observational versus simulation distinction, and precisely the same documented variable sets. a093 never documents residual sugar, a094 never documents a pH curve, and a095 documents culture alone; no missing value or negated dairy/beans is treated as positive evidence. All distribution descriptions match their own formats and record content: 0 CSV, 1 JSON, optional 2 consistent CSV or JSON; no payload download was attempted. Meaningful sentence-level and title variation, order/length changes and optional-field variation are present. Strict literal fact preservation is unresolved: for a092 the sugar example is 29.47 here versus 32.01 in 39031 and 11.5 in 39033; pH time examples differ as well. Numeric examples also change for a091/a093/a094/a096/a097/a098/a099/a100, along with fictional sites and publishers. a095 preserves the same single culture value but varies its surrounding text. Therefore this is not purely paraphrasing fixed observations; whether only schema-level preservation was intended needs clarification. a099 also has a measurement-title ambiguity not present in 39033. Full projected metadata were reviewed, not external files, systems or results. Query strings and exact paraphrases are not supplied; no authoritative identity check is required for these ten IDs. There is no observed no-answer conjunction or searchable answer key/grade tag. No corpus-wide or ranking claim is made.

CSV and two JSON synopses consistently describe fracture force, tempering conditions and particle diameter with matching units and example values. The two identical JSON synopses do not establish duplicated dataset records or contradictory content.

a079 positively documents simulated refrigerated shelf-life assessment of a liquid chocolate dairy beverage at Dune Valley Inner. Its title explicitly states simulation outputs. Root description, CSV synopsis and JSON synopsis agree on microbial concentration, chamber temperature and spoilage-time variables and example values.

Facts in both reviews are documented simulated variables, not claims that physical measurements were collected. Neither record supplies an administrative ledger process. No separate empirical context is invented, and the documented product/process subject matter is not erased merely because its values are simulated.
